acceptance: Replying to several review threads starts no more than one full oracle-review evaluation, or the decision to keep the trigger is recorded with the reason
A connector review or stand-in approval still re-evaluates the required check (test or recorded run)
context: Observed on PR #2751: 14 thread replies between 21:23 and 21:24 UTC on 2026-10-08 started 17 oracle-review runs, of which 13 were cancelled.
description:
`.github/workflows/oracle-review.yml` triggers on `pull_request_review: [submitted, dismissed]`. A reply in a review thread is a submitted review, so replying to N threads starts N runs. Concurrency cancels all but the last, but each one still takes a runner slot. On 2026-10-08 the core repo had CI queued for over 25 minutes while this happened.

Options:
- filter in a cheap first step: exit early unless the review is a connector review, or an approval by a listed attester;
- or keep the trigger and accept the cost.

Check first that the required check still re-evaluates when a real reviewer approves.
